findings.text: Companies House records the company's status as 'dissolved', with cessation on 10 October 2017.
The company was incorporated on 24 August 2015 and was 2.1 years old (778 days) at cessation.
No insolvency record is held for the company.
No charges are registered against the company.
The register shows 1 current officer, a director, PERSON 264, appointed 24 August 2015, with no other officers listed.
The overdue status of the accounts and confirmation statement is unknown, with no next due or last made up to dates recorded.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
